effects.target: any door lock requiring a key in the coordinate area
effects.trigger: SCP-860 is used in an eligible door lock
constraints: lock is located in the area of the given coordinates
lock is attached to a door
does not work on other locking devices

evidence.locator: SCP-860 can fit in any door lock that requires a key located in the area of the given coordinates, and will function identically to the correct key for that lock.

effects.trigger: SCP-860 is used to unlock and open a door

evidence.locator: When SCP-860 is used to unlock and open a door, the door does not lead to its usual destination.
As soon as any person enters SCP-860-1, the door automatically closes.
